title: Width-factor coordinate
statement: For an exponential breadth-first-search state $S$, the coordinate at index $4$ of its 17-entry counter vector is its width factor $X$; that is, this coordinate equals $S.X$.
replaced:
For every state $S$ of the exponential breadth-first search procedure, the width-factor
coordinate of its 17-entry register vector is $S.X$.
